infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: DMZ Scuba uses the camera to demonstrate how underwater depth affects visible colors and to identify marine life or gear in Dive Lens.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DMZ Scuba needs photo access so Dive Lens can identify marine life or gear from a picture you choose, and so you can pick a background photo for a dive profile share card.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: DMZ Scuba connects to your dive computer over Bluetooth to download your dive log.
